original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: vertical 9:16 architectural reference board for a premium realistic otome 2.5D/3D story package. Input image 1 is the layout/material master, not an edit target. Create TWO large separate exterior views stacked vertically with a clean WHITE gutter and no labels or captions. TOP: ordinary renovated older coastal-city low-rise apartment building with worn warm-ivory plaster, subtle aged masonry, dark window frames, simple black iron balcony railing, potted greenery. Focus on one floor's wide shallow balcony and window arrangement compatible with the reference two-bedroom apartment; soft daylight, ordinary neighborhood with no recognizable landmarks. BOTTOM: modest independent vintage motorcycle workshop in a low red-brick industrial building, wide dark metal roller shutter at front LEFT partly raised, separate glass pedestrian door and simple wood reception visible inside at front RIGHT, warm lamp over entry. Exterior matches the reference lower workshop. A small glimpse of forest-green motorcycle and rear tool wall can be visible. Coherent brick, wood, metal material, restrained realistic 3D detail. No people, logos, readable shop name, street address, country cues, watermark, diagrams or bottom text.
